comparison.objective: Select the n-type (100) wafer and mount it face-down on a dicing-tape mounter; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Read wafer flats, use two tweezer pairs, stand on edge, hand off, orient and centre versus fine fastening, collar adjustment and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Correct wafer centred with primary flat aligned and vacuum enabled versus two repeatable safe axial stops.
comparison.reason: Precision wafer identification, inversion and mounting are materially different from damping commissioning.
